source: repository configuration and direct endpoint observations

providers.name: GitHub Actions and CodeQL
providers.authority: CI execution, dependency review, and static-analysis evidence only; never YNX chain or user authority
providers.authentication: GitHub-provided short-lived workflow token with job-scoped permissions
providers.rateLimit: provider-enforced; exact repository allowance not yet recorded
providers.dataRetention: workflow logs and artifacts use repository settings; platform artifact upload requests 14 days
providers.dataRights: source and generated CI evidence are sent only through repository-authorized workflows
providers.health: latest reachable run 29930788053 detected a dependency failure; subsequent local access is TLS-unavailable
providers.fallback: run equivalent local gates and retain results as local-only evidence
providers.outageBehavior: block remote-CI completion claims and deployment promotion

providers.name: npm Registry Advisory and Package Service
providers.authority: JavaScript package metadata, package bytes, and vulnerability advisories only
providers.authentication: anonymous reads for public dependencies; no publish credential is configured by this platform
providers.dataRetention: request telemetry controlled by provider and not yet legally reviewed
providers.dataRights: only lockfile dependency identifiers and normal registry request metadata are transmitted
providers.health: package installation succeeded; advisory requests were intermittently unavailable
providers.fallback: use the committed lockfile and local cache for builds, but do not claim a current vulnerability audit
providers.outageBehavior: fail the remote audit gate or leave it unproven; never convert outage to success
